我们都是中国人。 (Wǒmen dōu shì Zhōngguó rén.) - We are all Chinese.
他们都喜欢喝茶。 (Tāmen dōu xǐhuan hē chá.) - They all like drinking tea.
这些都是王方的东西。 (Zhèxiē dōu shì Wáng Fāng de dōngxi.) - These are all Wang Fang's things.
昨天上午她去哪儿了？ (Zuótiān shàngwǔ tā qù nǎr le?) - Where did she go yesterday morning?
她买什么了？ (Tā mǎi shénme le?) - What did she buy?

王方买什么了？ (Wáng Fāng mǎi shénme le?) - What did Wang Fang buy?
王方的朋友买什么了？ (Wáng Fāng de péngyou mǎi shénme le?) - What did Wang Fang's friend buy?
妈妈去商店买了________。 (Māma qù shāngdiàn mǎile ________.) - Mom went to the shop and bought ________. (picture-description exercise)
她下午去学________了。 (Tā xiàwǔ qù xué ________ le.) - She went to learn ________ in the afternoon. (picture-description exercise)
桌子上________是张先生的东西。 (Zhuōzi shang ________ shì Zhāng xiānsheng de dōngxi.) - ________ on the table are Mr. Zhang's things. (picture-description exercise)
丽丽买了________衣服。 (Lìli mǎile ________ yīfu.) - Lili bought ________ clothes. (picture-description exercise)
你去商店买什么了？ (Nǐ qù shāngdiàn mǎi shénme le?) - What did you buy when you went to the shop?
我买了…… (Wǒ mǎile……) - I bought ……
星期一上午你做什么了？ (Xīngqī yī shàngwǔ nǐ zuò shénme le?) - What did you do on Monday morning?
我去电影院了。 (Wǒ qù diànyǐngyuàn le.) - I went to the cinema.
你看什么了？ (Nǐ kàn shénme le?) - What did you watch?
我看了一个中国电影。 (Wǒ kànle yí ge Zhōngguó diànyǐng.) - I watched a Chinese film.
你和李小姐是什么时候认识的？ (Nǐ hé Lǐ xiǎojiě shì shénme shíhou rènshi de?) - When did you and Miss Li first meet?
我们是2011年9月认识的。 (Wǒmen shì èr líng yī yī nián jiǔ yuè rènshi de.) - We met in September, 2011.
你们在哪儿认识的？ (Nǐmen zài nǎr rènshi de?) - Where did you meet each other?
我们是在学校认识的，她是我大学同学。 (Wǒmen shì zài xuéxiào rènshi de, tā shì wǒ dàxué tóngxué.) - We met in our university. She was my classmate.
你们是怎么来饭店的？ (Nǐmen shì zěnme lái fàndiàn de?) - How did you come here?
我们是坐出租车来的。 (Wǒmen shì zuò chūzūchē lái de.) - We came by taxi.
李先生呢？ (Lǐ xiānsheng ne?) - What about Mr. Li?
他是和朋友一起开车来的。 (Tā shì hé péngyou yìqǐ kāi chē lái de.) - He drove here with his friend.
很高兴认识您！李小姐。 (Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nín! Lǐ xiǎojiě.) - Nice to meet you, Miss Li.
认识你我也很高兴！ (Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng!) - Nice to meet you too.
听张先生说，您是坐飞机来北京的？ (Tīng Zhāng xiānsheng shuō, nín shì zuò fēijī lái Běijīng de?) - Mr. Zhang said you came to Beijing by plane, didn't you?
是的。 (Shì de.) - Yes, I did.
我是昨天来的。 (Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de.) - I came yesterday.
这是在北京买的。 (Zhè shì zài Běijīng mǎi de.) - This was bought in Beijing.
你们是怎么来饭店的？ (Nǐmen shì zěnme lái fàndiàn de?) - How did you come to the hotel?
我不是昨天来的。 (Wǒ bú shì zuótiān lái de.) - I did not come yesterday.
这不是在北京买的。 (Zhè bú shì zài Běijīng mǎi de.) - This was not bought in Beijing.
我们不是坐出租车来的。 (Wǒmen bú shì zuò chūzūchē lái de.) - We did not come by taxi.

你是在哪儿学的？ (Nǐ shì zài nǎr xué de?) - Where did you learn it?
在中国，常用的通信工具有电话机和手机两种。 (Zài Zhōngguó, chángyòng de tōngxìn gōngjù yǒu diànhuàjī hé shǒujī liǎng zhǒng.) - In China, there are two kinds of common communication tools—telephones and cell phones.

电话机号码一般为7-8位，比如2027816、82304156，不同地区的电话机号码位数不同。 (Diànhuàjī hàomǎ yìbān wéi 7-8 wèi, bǐrú 2027816, 82304156, bùtóng dìqū de diànhuàjī hàomǎ wèishù bùtóng.) - A telephone number usually has 7-8 digits, for example, 2027816, 82304156. Telephone numbers in different regions have different numbers of digits.

手机号码的位数没有地区的差别，都是11位，比如13576983311。 (Shǒujī hàomǎ de wèishù méiyǒu dìqū de chābié, dōu shì 11 wèi, bǐrú 13576983311.) - Cell phone numbers, however, always have 11 digits regardless of region, as in 13576983311.

由于手机号码位数较多，读时一般切分为“3-4-4”的停顿模式，比如139-0107-8866。 (Yóuyú shǒujī hàomǎ wèishù jiào duō, dú shí yìbān qiēfēn wéi “3-4-4” de tíngdùn móshì, bǐrú 139-0107-8866.) - Since a cell phone number has many digits, it is read with pauses following the pattern "3-4-4", such as 139-0107-8866.
其中号码中的“1”要读成“yāo”。 (Qízhōng hàomǎ zhōng de “1” yào dúchéng “yāo”.) - "1" is read as "yāo" in a phone number.
